headline: Public source repo exists but no third-party audit found; Provenance blockchain is not EVM-compatible so on-chain bytecode verification tooling is inapplicable
short_headline: No audit; non-EVM chain limits verification

findings.text: Figure Markets Exchange runs on Provenance Blockchain (CosmWasm/Cosmos SDK), which is not an EVM chain and is not supported by the DeFiPunkd read API or any Etherscan-equivalent explorer accessible this run. The Provenance explorer (explorer.provenance.io) returned an access-denied error. No on-chain bytecode verification status could be confirmed. The deployed ATS smart contract uses Wasm bytecode; no deployed mainnet contract addresses are published in the GitHub README (only testnet code IDs are listed).

A public source repository (FigureTechnologies/ats-smart-contract) exists on GitHub, written in Rust (ProvWasm), with 329 commits and latest release v1.0.1 (commit 29a78da, Sep 9 2024). The README documents testnet deployments only; no mainnet contract addresses or code IDs are pinned, so source-to-deployment correspondence cannot be confirmed for production.

No audit links are recorded in protocol.audit_links. No security audit report was discovered via website inspection (figuremarkets.com), GitHub repository (FigureTechnologies/ats-smart-contract), or web search. The protocol has no publicly documented third-party audit of the ATS smart contract.

No auditor identified. No recognized Solidity or CosmWasm audit firm (Trail of Bits, Zellic, Halborn, OtterSec, Oak Security, etc.) has been linked to any review of this contract. This is a red signal for the V4 criterion.
Post-audit drift cannot be assessed because no audit baseline exists. The repository shows active development with v1.0.1 released September 2024. No audit was found against any version.

Provenance CosmWasm contracts use a migrate pattern rather than EVM proxy patterns. The proxy/implementation distinction is not directly applicable. However, the lack of any verifiable on-chain deployment record means implementation verification cannot be confirmed.

steelman.red: No third-party security audit has been published for the ATS smart contract at any version, and the Provenance blockchain is not accessible through standard EVM verification tooling, making independent bytecode confirmation impossible for an external reviewer.
steelman.orange: The source code is publicly available on GitHub under an Apache-2.0 license with a full commit history and CI/CD pipeline; the protocol operates on a purpose-built financial blockchain with institutional users, suggesting internal review processes may compensate for lack of a published external audit.
steelman.green: The ATS smart contract is open-source Rust/CosmWasm code with 329 commits, 33 releases, and an active development history, which provides meaningful transparency even without a formal external audit.

rationale.verdict: Choosing red because the protocol.audit_links field is empty, no third-party security audit was found through any evidence source this run, and no on-chain deployment addresses are publicly documented for mainnet. The steelman for red is the clearest: absence of any published external audit is an unambiguous red criterion per the grade rules, and the inability to perform on-chain bytecode verification due to Provenance being an unsupported chain reinforces this rating. The orange steelman (open source code, institutional users) does not overcome the mandatory audit requirement for a green or orange grade.

evidence.shows: Figure Markets Exchange website confirming the platform runs on Provenance Blockchain; confirms product offerings including crypto exchange, YLDS stablecoin, and Democratized Prime; no audit links present

Public GitHub repository for the Provenance ATS smart contract (Rust/CosmWasm), Apache-2.0 license, 329 commits, latest release v1.0.1 (Sep 9 2024); README lists testnet deployments only (code IDs for pio-testnet-1), no mainnet contract addresses; no audit links present in repository
Latest release v1.0.1 dated Sep 9 2024, commit 29a78da; only change is upgrade to provwasm 2.3.0; no audit references

unknowns: V1: Provenance blockchain (CosmWasm/Cosmos SDK) is not supported by DeFiPunkd read API or accessible Etherscan-equivalent; explorer.provenance.io returned access-denied this run; on-chain bytecode verification status of deployed mainnet ATS contract cannot be confirmed
V1: No mainnet contract addresses or code IDs for the ATS smart contract are published in the GitHub README or website; only testnet deployments documented
V2: Source-to-mainnet-deployment correspondence cannot be confirmed because no mainnet contract address or code ID is publicly documented
V3: No audit links in protocol.audit_links; no audit discovered via website, GitHub, or web search for the ATS smart contract
V5: Post-audit drift assessment blocked by absence of any audit baseline
V1-offchain: Provenance chain explorer fetch failed (access denied); on-chain reads not possible via DeFiPunkd API for this chain

protocol_metadata.about: Figure Markets Exchange is a regulated OTC and crypto exchange built on Provenance Blockchain, a Cosmos SDK proof-of-stake chain purpose-built for financial services. Users can trade crypto assets (BTC, ETH, HASH), tokenized real-world assets, and SEC-registered securities using MPC-based self-custody wallets. The exchange logic is implemented as a CosmWasm smart contract (ATS smart contract) that facilitates bilateral ask/bid matching with atomic on-chain settlement. The platform also offers Democratized Prime (HELOC-backed yield pools) and YLDS, the first SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin native to a public blockchain.
